twinkie: disable tracing when injecting packets The tracing runs a higher priority task (SNIFFER) than the packet injection (on CONSOLE task) and both RX and TX are using the same buffer, so when we are sending a packet, we are getting immediately preempted by the tracer and bad stuffs happen.
